name: Dal Makhani
description: Slow-cooked creamy black lentil curry with butter and aromatic spices.

steps.title: Soak
steps.description: Soak urad dal and rajma until softened.

steps.title: Cook lentils
steps.description: Cook the soaked lentils until tender.

steps.title: Make masala
steps.description: Cook cumin, onion, ginger, garlic, tomato and spices.

steps.title: Combine
steps.description: Add cooked lentils and simmer until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Add butter, cream and kasuri methi; adjust salt.

name: Pav Bhaji
description: Mumbai-style spiced mashed vegetable bhaji served with butter-toasted pav.

steps.title: Boil vegetables
steps.description: Boil potato, peas and other vegetables until soft.

steps.title: Make base
steps.description: Cook onion, ginger, garlic, capsicum and tomatoes.

steps.title: Mash
steps.description: Add boiled vegetables and mash everything together.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Add pav bhaji masala, chilli and salt; cook until thick.

steps.title: Toast pav
steps.description: Toast pav with butter on a hot pan.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve hot bhaji with buttered pav, coriander and lemon.

name: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
description: Aromatic vegetarian Hyderabadi-style dum biryani with basmati rice, vegetables, herbs and whole spices.

steps.title: Prepare rice
steps.description: Rinse and partially cook basmati rice with whole spices and salt.

steps.title: Prepare masala
steps.description: Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, chilli and spices with yogurt.

steps.title: Layer
steps.description: Layer rice, masala, mint, coriander and fried onion.

steps.title: Dum cook
steps.description: Cover tightly and cook on low heat until aromatic and fully cooked.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Rest briefly, fluff gently and serve hot.

name: Creamy Pesto Pasta
description: Creamy pasta tossed with basil pesto, parmesan and black pepper.

steps.title: Boil pasta
steps.description: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente.

steps.title: Prepare sauce
steps.description: Warm butter and garlic, then add cream and pesto.

steps.title: Combine
steps.description: Toss cooked pasta with the creamy pesto sauce.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Add parmesan and black pepper; loosen with pasta water if needed.

name: Manchurian Dry
description: Crispy vegetable balls tossed in a tangy garlic-soy sauce.

steps.title: Prep vegetables
steps.description: Finely chop cabbage, carrot, garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Make balls
steps.description: Mix veggies with cornflour and flour, shape into small balls and deep-fry until golden.

steps.title: Make sauce
steps.description: Saute garlic and ginger, add soy sauce, vinegar and a splash of water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.description: Toss the fried balls in the sauce with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Aloo Paratha
description: Whole-wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced mashed potatoes.

steps.title: Boil potatoes
steps.description: Boil, peel and mash the potatoes.

steps.title: Make stuffing
steps.description: Mix mashed potato with chillies, coriander, cumin and spices.

steps.title: Make dough
steps.description: Knead a soft wheat dough and rest for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Stuff and roll
steps.description: Stuff dough balls with the potato filling and roll out gently.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden spots appear on both sides.

name: Gobi Paratha
description: Whole-wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced grated cauliflower.

steps.title: Grate cauliflower
steps.description: Grate the cauliflower finely and squeeze out excess water.

steps.title: Make stuffing
steps.description: Mix grated cauliflower with chillies, ginger, coriander and spices.

steps.title: Make dough
steps.description: Knead a soft wheat dough and rest for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Stuff and roll
steps.description: Stuff dough balls with the cauliflower filling and roll out gently.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.

name: Veg Burger
description: A crisp vegetable patty layered with fresh veggies in a soft bun.

steps.title: Make patty
steps.description: Mash boiled potato and peas with spices, shape into patties and coat in breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Pan-fry
steps.description: Shallow fry the patties until crisp and golden.

steps.title: Toast buns
steps.description: Toast the burger buns with a little butter.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Layer lettuce, tomato, patty, cheese and mayo between the buns and serve.

name: Veg Tacos
description: Crunchy taco shells filled with spiced beans, veggies and salsa.

steps.title: Cook filling
steps.description: Saute onion, capsicum, cooked black beans and cumin until warmed through.

steps.title: Warm tortillas
steps.description: Lightly warm the tortillas or taco shells.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Fill each shell with the bean mix, lettuce, tomato, cheese and salsa.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve immediately while the shells are crisp.

name: Idli
description: Soft, fluffy steamed rice cakes served with chutney and sambhar.

steps.title: Soak
steps.description: Soak rice and urad dal separately with fenugreek seeds for 4-6 hours.

steps.title: Grind
steps.description: Grind both into a smooth batter and mix together.

steps.title: Ferment
steps.description: Leave the batter to ferment overnight until it rises.

steps.title: Steam
steps.description: Pour into greased idli moulds and steam for 10-12 minutes until a knife comes out clean.

name: Chur Chur Naan
description: Flaky, shredded naan enriched with ghee and butter.

steps.title: Make dough
steps.description: Knead flour with yogurt, baking powder, milk and salt into a soft dough; rest 2 hours.

steps.title: Shape
steps.description: Divide into balls and roll into naan shapes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Cook on a hot tawa or in a tandoor until charred spots appear.

steps.title: Chur chur
steps.description: Crush the hot naan lightly between your palms and brush generously with ghee and butter.

name: Cenona's Pizza
description: House-special loaded pizza with a generous mix of vegetables and cheese.

steps.title: Prep base
steps.description: Spread pizza sauce generously over the base.

steps.title: Load toppings
steps.description: Layer on mozzarella, capsicum, corn, onion and tomato.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake until the crust is golden and cheese bubbly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Slice and serve hot with a sprinkle of black pepper.

name: Thepla
description: Soft spiced flatbread made with fenugreek leaves and wheat flour.

steps.title: Make dough
steps.description: Mix wheat flour, chopped fenugreek leaves, besan, yogurt, spices and oil into a soft dough.

steps.title: Rest
steps.description: Rest the dough for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Roll and cook
steps.description: Roll into thin rounds and cook on a hot tawa with a little oil until golden on both sides.

name: Paneer Wrap
description: Soft rotis rolled with spiced paneer tikka and crunchy vegetables.

steps.title: Marinate paneer
steps.description: Marinate paneer cubes in yogurt and spices, then pan-fry with capsicum and onion.

steps.title: Roll rotis
steps.description: Roll out and cook soft wheat rotis.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Spread green chutney and mayo on the roti, add the paneer filling and roll tightly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Slice in half and serve warm.

name: Green Veg. Wrap
description: A fresh wrap loaded with crisp greens and a tangy chutney.

steps.title: Roll rotis
steps.description: Roll out and cook soft wheat rotis.

steps.title: Prep veggies
steps.description: Shred cabbage, carrot and capsicum thinly.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Spread green chutney on the roti, pile on the vegetables and sprouts, and roll tightly.

name: Fries
description: Golden, crispy potato fries dusted with chaat masala.

steps.title: Cut potatoes
steps.description: Cut potatoes into even batons and soak in water for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Par-boil
steps.description: Par-boil briefly, then pat completely dry.

steps.title: Fry
steps.description: Deep-fry until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Toss with salt and chaat masala and serve hot.

name: Patra
description: Colocasia leaves layered with a spiced besan paste, steamed and pan-fried.

steps.title: Make paste
steps.description: Mix besan with tamarind, jaggery, turmeric, chilli powder and water into a thick paste.

steps.title: Layer leaves
steps.description: Spread the paste over colocasia leaves, stack and roll tightly.

steps.title: Steam
steps.description: Steam the rolls for 20-25 minutes, then cool and slice.

steps.title: Temper
steps.description: Pan-fry the slices with a mustard-seed and sesame tempering before serving.

name: Masala Dosa
description: Crispy fermented rice-and-lentil crepe filled with spiced potato masala.

steps.title: Ferment batter
steps.description: Soak, grind and ferment rice and urad dal into a smooth dosa batter overnight.

steps.title: Make potato masala
steps.description: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, add onion, boiled potato and turmeric; mash lightly.

steps.title: Spread dosa
steps.description: Spread a ladle of batter thin on a hot griddle and drizzle with oil until crisp.

steps.title: Fill and fold
steps.description: Place the potato masala in the centre, fold the dosa and serve hot.

name: Menduwada
description: Crisp, fluffy lentil doughnuts served with coconut chutney and sambhar.

steps.title: Soak and grind
steps.description: Soak urad dal for 4 hours and grind into a thick, fluffy batter.

steps.title: Add flavour
steps.description: Fold in chopped green chilli, ginger and curry leaves.

steps.title: Shape
steps.description: Wet your hands, shape small doughnuts and slide into hot oil.

steps.title: Fry
steps.description: Deep-fry until golden brown and crisp; serve with chutney and sambhar.

name: Gujarati Thali
description: A wholesome everyday Gujarati thali of dal, sabzi, rotli and rice.

steps.title: Cook dal
steps.description: Cook toor dal with turmeric and a touch of jaggery.

steps.title: Make sabzi
steps.description: Prepare a simple spiced potato sabzi.

steps.title: Roll rotli
steps.description: Roll out and cook soft wheat rotlis with ghee.

steps.title: Cook rice
steps.description: Steam the rice and plate everything together with papad.

name: Veg. Noodles
description: Stir-fried noodles tossed with crunchy vegetables in a savoury soy sauce.

steps.title: Boil noodles
steps.description: Boil the noodles until just tender, drain and toss with a little oil.

steps.title: Stir-fry veggies
steps.description: Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat until crisp-tender.

steps.title: Combine
steps.description: Add the noodles, soy sauce and vinegar, and toss everything together.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Premium Thali
description: An elaborate thali with a rich paneer curry, dal, rice, naan and dessert.

steps.title: Cook paneer curry
steps.description: Simmer paneer in a rich tomato-onion gravy finished with cream.

steps.title: Cook dal
steps.description: Prepare a simple tempered toor dal.

steps.title: Make naan and rice
steps.description: Cook naans on a tawa and steam the basmati rice.

steps.title: Plate
steps.description: Plate the curry, dal, rice, naan, papad and shrikhand together.

name: Vadapav
description: Spiced potato fritters sandwiched in a soft pav with chutneys.

steps.title: Make filling
steps.description: Mash boiled potato with a mustard-curry leaf tempering, turmeric and chillies.

steps.title: Shape and batter
steps.description: Shape into balls and dip in a seasoned besan batter.

steps.title: Fry
steps.description: Deep-fry until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Slit the pav, spread chutneys, add garlic chutney and the vada, and serve hot.

name: Cheese Panipuri
description: A cheesy fusion twist on classic pani puri with a molten cheese filling.

steps.title: Make pani
steps.description: Blend mint, coriander and pani puri masala with water and strain.

steps.title: Prep filling
steps.description: Mix mashed potato with grated mozzarella.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Fill each puri with the potato-cheese mix and dunk in the spiced water just before serving.

name: Khaman
description: Soft, spongy steamed besan cakes tempered with mustard seeds.

steps.title: Make batter
steps.description: Whisk besan with water, sugar, lemon juice and salt into a smooth batter.

steps.title: Steam
steps.description: Add eno, pour into a greased tin and steam for 15-18 minutes until spongy.

steps.title: Temper
steps.description: Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and green chilli in oil and pour over.

steps.title: Cut and serve
steps.description: Cool slightly, cut into squares and serve.

name: Spicy Veg. Noodles
description: Fiery stir-fried noodles with schezwan sauce and crunchy vegetables.

steps.title: Boil noodles
steps.description: Boil the noodles until just tender and toss with a little oil.

steps.title: Stir-fry
steps.description: Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.

steps.title: Add sauces
steps.description: Add schezwan sauce and soy sauce, then toss in the noodles.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Cook briefly until well coated and serve immediately.

name: Dal Tadka
description: Yellow lentils simmered and finished with a smoky ghee tempering.

steps.title: Boil dal
steps.description: Boil the toor dal with turmeric until soft and mash lightly.

steps.title: Make tadka
steps.description: Heat ghee, temper cumin and garlic, add onion and tomato until softened.

steps.title: Combine
steps.description: Pour the tempering into the boiled dal and simmer for a few minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Kaju Paneer Masala
description: Paneer and cashews simmered in a creamy, rich cashew-tomato gravy.

steps.title: Make gravy base
steps.description: Cook onion, ginger, garlic, tomato and half the cashews, then blend smooth.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Simmer the gravy with butter and cream until rich.

steps.title: Add paneer
steps.description: Add paneer cubes and remaining whole cashews, simmer gently.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Adjust seasoning with garam masala and serve hot.

name: Garlic Butter Naan
description: Soft leavened naan brushed with garlic butter.

steps.title: Make dough
steps.description: Knead flour with yogurt, baking powder and salt into a soft dough, rest 2 hours.

steps.title: Shape
steps.description: Divide and roll into naan shapes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Cook on a hot tawa or in a tandoor until puffed and charred in spots.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Brush with garlic butter and chopped coriander before serving.

name: Punjabi Thali
description: A hearty Punjabi spread of paneer curry, dal makhani, rice and naan.

steps.title: Cook rajma
steps.description: Simmer boiled rajma in a spiced tomato-onion gravy.

steps.title: Cook paneer curry
steps.description: Prepare a buttery paneer curry finished with cream.

steps.title: Make naan and rice
steps.description: Cook naans and steam the basmati rice.

steps.title: Plate
steps.description: Serve the curries with rice, naan and papad.

name: Paneer Tikka Dry
description: Smoky, char-grilled paneer cubes marinated in a yogurt-spice mix.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.description: Marinate paneer, capsicum and onion cubes in yogurt, ginger-garlic and spices for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Skewer
steps.description: Thread onto skewers alternating paneer and vegetables.

steps.title: Grill
steps.description: Grill or pan-sear until charred at the edges.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Squeeze lemon over and serve hot with mint chutney.

name: Veg. Steamed Momos
description: Delicate steamed dumplings filled with finely chopped mixed vegetables.

steps.title: Make dough
steps.description: Knead flour with water into a smooth dough and rest 20 minutes.

steps.title: Make filling
steps.description: Finely chop vegetables and mix with garlic, ginger and soy sauce.

steps.title: Shape momos
steps.description: Roll small discs, fill and pleat into momos.

steps.title: Steam
steps.description: Steam for 10-12 minutes until the wrapper turns translucent.

name: Dhokla
description: Light, fluffy steamed besan cakes with a tempered mustard-curry leaf topping.

steps.title: Make batter
steps.description: Whisk besan with yogurt, water, sugar and salt into a smooth batter.

steps.title: Steam
steps.description: Add eno, pour into a greased tin and steam for 15-18 minutes.

steps.title: Temper
steps.description: Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and green chilli, then pour over with a little water.

steps.title: Cut and serve
steps.description: Cool slightly, cut into pieces and serve.

name: Farm Fresh Pizza
description: A garden-fresh pizza loaded with seasonal vegetables.

steps.title: Prep base
steps.description: Spread pizza sauce over the base.

steps.title: Add veggies
steps.description: Top with mozzarella and a generous mix of fresh vegetables.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake until the crust is golden and the cheese melted.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Garnish with fresh basil and serve.

name: Dal Chawal
description: Simple, comforting tempered lentils served over steamed rice.

steps.title: Boil dal
steps.description: Boil toor dal with turmeric until soft.

steps.title: Temper
steps.description: Temper cumin, onion and tomato in ghee and add to the dal, simmer briefly.

steps.title: Cook rice
steps.description: Steam the basmati rice separately.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve the dal hot over steamed rice.

name: Veg. Cheese Burger
description: A juicy vegetable patty burger loaded with melted cheese.

steps.title: Make patty
steps.description: Mash boiled potato and peas with spices, shape into patties and coat in breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Pan-fry
steps.description: Shallow fry the patties until crisp and golden.

steps.title: Melt cheese
steps.description: Place cheese slices on the hot patty to melt slightly.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Layer lettuce, tomato, the cheesy patty and mayo between toasted buns and serve.

name: Misal Pav
description: Spicy sprouted moth bean curry topped with crunchy farsan, served with pav.

steps.title: Sprout beans
steps.description: Soak and sprout the moth beans overnight, then boil until tender.

steps.title: Make curry
steps.description: Cook onion and tomato with turmeric and red chilli powder into a spicy gravy, add the sprouted beans and simmer.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Top the curry generously with sev, farsan and coriander.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve hot with buttered pav and a wedge of lemon.

name: Kimchi Ramen
description: Spicy Korean ramen noodles in a savoury broth topped with tangy kimchi.

steps.title: Boil noodles
steps.description: Cook the ramen noodles in boiling water until just tender.

steps.title: Make broth
steps.description: Simmer garlic, soy sauce and kimchi with water into a savoury broth.

steps.title: Combine
steps.description: Add the noodles to the broth and simmer briefly.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Top with a soft-boiled egg, spring onion, sesame oil and sesame seeds.
